customer: hey so i paid off my truck loan a while back but the title stil shows the bank as lienholder?? trying to sell my pickup to northwind, is that gonna be a problem
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Per our article "My loan is paid off but the lien is still on the title," this means the lien hasn't been released yet, so the first step is to ask your lender for a lien release letter. If you can't get one, you can sign our lien release request, form NW-LRL-1, and we'll contact the lender for you, though this can add 1 to 2 weeks. In the meantime, we can still make an offer on your pickup and book your appointment while you wait.
